rules.description: Critical SPREC or contextual metadata is missing.
SPREC code is unknown, including X or XXX.
SPREC code is syntactically invalid or not recognized in the seeded catalog.
SPREC code belongs to a different matrix or incompatible SPREC axis.
Other or non-standard value lacks validated local interpretation.
Monitoring is absent when required by the specimen context.
Matrix, SPREC axis, event, or context are semantically incompatible.
Analytical workflow context is absent for a conditional severity.
Not scored conditions are routed through governance and never as zero severity.
